notes.title: 👽Remote Planets Is Out NOW!🚀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134037/f8b46ed5d5f1fc90a7defdf6116f6d3d6b5045c2.png[/img]

Hey, folks!
I'm happy to announce that Remote Planets is available NOW!! I'm happy to finally share it with you all, I hope you enjoy playing it!

Cheers!
Zuza

notes.title: 👽Remote Planets Is Releasing On April 24th!🚀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134037/f8b46ed5d5f1fc90a7defdf6116f6d3d6b5045c2.png[/img]

Hey, folks!
I'm happy to announce that Remote Planets is releasing on Steam [b]on April 24th[/b] as part of the Steam Puzzle Fest event. The game contains over 120 challenging puzzles, a colorful world and a cast of quirky aliens to chat with! I hope you will enjoy it.

Cheers!
Zuza

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134037/2fd1514f732c7d6404f19549b524f933dee5100d.gif[/img]

notes.title: 🧩 Remote Planets - Demo Stream And Dev Q&A
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134037/f8b46ed5d5f1fc90a7defdf6116f6d3d6b5045c2.png[/img]

[b]Hello there![/b] Thank you for checking out our stream. Feel free to ask questions in chat!

[b]Remote Planets[/b] is a puzzle game taking you on a journey through a vibrant, colorful alien world filled with unique logic challenges. As you solve sets of levels and discover unique mechanics, you will meet many friendly, colorful characters guiding you along the path. The game contains over 100 hand-crafted puzzles grouped into sets exploring unique mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134037/a6d0dc0e23ff6c9e8cdf026b87ecd4bf1792392b.gif[/img]

[b]Remote Planets[/b] comes out in [b]April 2023[/b]. Wishlist it and play the demo now!
